mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, PINNED_YN = NVL(#{pinnedYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, n.ADMIN_ID AS adminId, m.NAME AS adminName, n.TITLE AS title, n.HIT_COUNT AS hitCount, TO_CHAR(n.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.ADMIN_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE n.PINNED_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY n.NOTICE_ID DESC

SELECT n.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, n.ADMIN_ID AS adminId, m.NAME AS adminName, n.TITLE AS title, n.PINNED_YN AS pinnedYn, n.STATUS AS status, n.HIT_COUNT AS hitCount, TO_CHAR(n.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt, NVL(f.fileCount, 0) AS fileCount FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.ADMIN_ID = m.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT NOTICE_ID, COUNT(*) AS fileCount FROM NOTICE_FILE GROUP BY NOTICE_ID ) f ON n.NOTICE_ID = f.NOTICE_ID ORDER BY n.PINNED_YN DESC, n.NOTICE_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET HIT_COUNT = HIT_COUNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, n.ADMIN_ID AS adminId, m.NAME AS adminName, n.TITLE AS title, n.CONTENT AS content, n.PINNED_YN AS pinnedYn, n.STATUS AS status, n.HIT_COUNT AS hitCount, TO_CHAR(n.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdAt FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.ADMIN_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE n.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE AS title FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID > #{noticeId} ORDER BY NOTICE_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, TITLE AS title FROM NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID < #{noticeId} ORDER BY NOTICE_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT NOTICE_FILE_ID AS noticeFileId, NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME AS originalFileName, FILE_PATH AS filePath FROM NOTICE_FILE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
SELECT NOTICE_FILE_ID AS noticeFileId, NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME AS originalFileName, FILE_PATH AS filePath FROM NOTICE_FILE WHERE NOTICE_FILE_ID = #{noticeFileId}
